pre2020_kev_subset.note: Only KEV members published before 2020 were materialised; this is not the full 1999-2019 archive.

retrieval_method: git clone --filter=blob:none --no-checkout --depth 1 + git sparse-checkout set /cves/<year>/ (2020-2026); pre-2020 KEV members fetched individually with git cat-file --batch
scope_note: The full historical archive was deliberately not downloaded. Identifiers published before 2020 are ingested from the legacy extract, except KEV members, whose cvelistV5 records are fetched individually so dual-source conflicts remain visible.
